versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x01, 0x07, 0x11 or 0x12, the Dcm module shall calculate the number of DTC s using Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDTC() after having set the DEM-filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.9.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x01, 0x07, 0x11 or 0x12, the Dcm module shall calculate the number of DTC s using Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDTC() after having set the DEM-filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.7.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunc- tion 0x01, 0x07 or 0x12, the Dcm module shall calculate the number of DTC s using Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDTC() after having set the DEM-filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.7.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunc- tion 0x01, 0x07 or 0x12, the Dcm module shall calculate the number of DTC s using Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDTC() after having set the DEM-filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.5.
